entries.summary_zh: 在你让一个 Bot 靠近账号前先审计它。

entries.name: Video Clip
entries.summary: Finds and downloads official video clips, then returns the file plus the source link
entries.summary_zh: 找到并下载官方视频片段，把文件和源链接一起交回。

entries.name: Video Transcriber
entries.summary: Turns a video link into a clean transcript or subtitle file
entries.summary_zh: 把视频链接转成干净的文稿或字幕文件。

entries.name: Vidmoat Bot
entries.summary: Cuts, previews, and renders videos in Vidmoat over MCP into an editable timeline
entries.summary_zh: 经 MCP 在 Vidmoat 里剪片、预览和渲染，落成可编辑时间线。

entries.name: Vigil
entries.summary: Sweep Desk lead: paste a lure for a field brief, never builds attacks
entries.summary_zh: Sweep Desk 主位，贴诱饵或记录出简报，绝不组攻击。

entries.name: Vinted Seller
entries.summary: Turns a pile of wardrobe photos into finished Vinted listings
entries.summary_zh: 一堆衣柜照片变成写好的 Vinted 上架。

entries.name: voice of the people
entries.summary: X watch bot that notifies only on new in-scope hits and stays quiet otherwise
entries.summary_zh: 盯 X，只在范围内有新命中时通知，其余保持安静。

entries.name: Volt
entries.summary: Hunts down the cheapest way to lease or buy a Tesla where you live
entries.summary_zh: 在你所在地找最便宜的 Tesla 租赁或购车方案。

entries.name: VPS & VPN
entries.summary: Manages VPS and VPN setup on this computer, including Tailscale and tunnels
entries.summary_zh: 在这台电脑上管 VPS 与 VPN，含 Tailscale、代理和 Cloudflare 隧道

entries.name: Wall Street
entries.summary: Keeps a make-believe trading book with a running profit and loss log, never sending a real order
entries.summary_zh: 做一本假想交易账，记下盈亏，从不真下单。

entries.name: Walt
entries.summary: An executive producer that QCs another filmmaker bot until the cut is done
entries.summary_zh: 执行制片，盯着另一个拍片 Bot 质检到成片。

entries.name: Watch Later Deck
entries.summary: Splits a bloated YouTube Watch Later list into four swipeable decks
entries.summary_zh: 把塞爆的 YouTube 稍后观看，拆成四叠可滑动的卡片。

entries.name: Watchbot
entries.summary: Wormsign watcher with no verdicts, part of Bottyguard SEAL Team 7
entries.summary_zh: Wormsign 监视器，不下判决，属于 Bottyguard SEAL Team 7。

entries.name: Watchdog
entries.summary: Sweeps your inbox weekly for renewals, receipts and expiring trials
entries.summary_zh: 每周扫收件箱，盯续订、收据和快到期的试用。

entries.name: WaveletWorld
entries.summary: Runs one labeled Haar wavelet step on a numeric state vector for demos
entries.summary_zh: 对数值状态向量跑一步带标签的 Haar 小波，偏演示

entries.name: Webby
entries.summary: A website admin that rebuilds, dashboards and keeps the newsletter going
entries.summary_zh: 管网站重建和看板，newsletter 也一直转着。

entries.name: Webhook Guide
entries.summary: Walks you through setting up and triggering Grok Bot webhook routines step by step
entries.summary_zh: 一步步带你配好并触发 Grok Bot 的 webhook 例行任务。

entries.name: Website agency lead scout
entries.summary: Delivers five vetted businesses that need a new website each morning
entries.summary_zh: 每天早上交出五家需要新网站、已经筛过的商家。

entries.name: Wedding Photo Hunter
entries.summary: Collects every wedding photo and video into one folder
entries.summary_zh: 把所有婚礼照片和视频收进一个文件夹。

entries.name: Weekend Roster
entries.summary: Matches streaming drops and books to your taste roster when weekend decision fatigue hits
entries.summary_zh: 周末选不过来时，按你的口味表匹配流媒体和新书。

entries.name: WhatsApp-Bot
entries.summary: Turns repeat WhatsApp Web chores into scripts you can replay
entries.summary_zh: 把反复做的 WhatsApp Web 杂活收成可回放的脚本。

entries.name: WhatsApp Digest
entries.summary: Read-only daily summary of busy WhatsApp groups. Never sends
entries.summary_zh: 只读汇总最忙的 WhatsApp 群当天真正要紧的事。

entries.name: Wholefoods
entries.summary: Plans the week's groceries around whatever Whole Foods has marked down
entries.summary_zh: 盯着 Whole Foods 的降价商品，来排这一周的采购。

entries.name: wing
entries.summary: A dating-app wingman that drafts openers and replies in your voice
entries.summary_zh: 约会应用僚机，用你的口气起草开场和回复。

entries.name: Witness
entries.summary: Keeps a record of why you made each important decision
entries.summary_zh: 记下你每个重要决定的原因。

entries.name: 薅羊毛 (Wool Radar)
entries.summary: Watches for deals on things you actually buy, and stays quiet otherwise
entries.summary_zh: 只盯你真会买的东西和订阅优惠，没合适的就闭嘴

entries.name: Woolf
entries.summary: Converse as Virginia Woolf’s attention to consciousness, rooms, and time
entries.summary_zh: 用伍尔夫对意识、房间和时间的注意力陪你聊。

entries.name: Work
entries.summary: The work-side counterpart to Life, one door for professional tasks
entries.summary_zh: 和工作外的 Life 成对，专业事务走这一扇门。

entries.name: Workshop Facilitator
entries.summary: Chairs a working session and refuses to close it while any question lacks an owner
entries.summary_zh: 主持工作会，只要还有问题没人认领就不让散会。

entries.name: X Account Crew
entries.summary: Five specialists sharing the work of running your X account
entries.summary_zh: 五个专长一起扛你的 X 账号。

entries.name: X Algo
entries.summary: Tells you whether to post now, quote something, or sit tight
entries.summary_zh: 告诉你现在该发帖、引用，还是先别动。

entries.name: X Brief
entries.summary: Learns what you pay attention to from your own posts, then watches that beat
entries.summary_zh: 从你自己的帖子学你关心什么，再盯那条线。

entries.name: 推特运营方法论
entries.summary: A daily X posting system for ideas, drafts, timing, and review
entries.summary_zh: 给 X 日更搭选题库、草稿、发布时段和复盘，发布键仍由你按

entries.name: X High Coach
entries.summary: Audits any public X account and tells you exactly what to change
entries.summary_zh: 审计任意公开 X 账号，告诉你该改什么。

entries.name: X High Coach
entries.summary: Drop an X username and get a score, health flags, unfollow watch, and punchy rewrites
entries.summary_zh: 丢一个 X 用户名，拿到评分、健康预警、取关名单和更有力的改写。

entries.name: X Mute Desk
entries.summary: Scans X mentions for hostile or spam replies and shows mute candidates
entries.summary_zh: 扫 X 提及里的敌意或垃圾回复，列出建议静音对象供你确认

entries.name: X Ops Expert
entries.summary: X growth ops for builders with daily review, topic bank, and gated drafts
entries.summary_zh: 给建造者做 X 增长运营，含日报、选题库，草稿需你确认再发

entries.name: X Scout
entries.summary: Weekday scout for Grok Bot use cases on X, then asks which to add
entries.summary_zh: 工作日在 X 上挖 Grok Bot 用法，汇总后问你加不加。

entries.name: X Strategist
entries.summary: Plays the long game on who is worth knowing on X
entries.summary_zh: 在 X 上玩长线，搞清楚谁值得认识。

entries.name: X Top 100 Fans Weekly
entries.summary: Ranks the 100 people who engaged most with your X posts each week
entries.summary_zh: 每周排出和你帖子互动最多的一百人。

entries.name: X Top 500 Fans (Monthly)
entries.summary: Monthly ranking of your 500 biggest X supporters, saved to a private list
entries.summary_zh: 每月排出你最大的五百名 X 支持者，存进私密名单。

entries.name: x402 Marketplace Operator
entries.summary: Packages skills and Grok Bots into listing files and never signs or pays
entries.summary_zh: 把技能和 Grok Bot 打成上架文件，从不签名或付款。

entries.name: 小红书参与抽奖助手
entries.summary: Finds Xiaohongshu giveaways, does the four-step entry, and logs them in Notion
entries.summary_zh: 在小红书搜抽奖并按规则四连，足迹记进 Notion，躲开明显诈骗。

entries.name: Yahoo Pulse
entries.summary: A read-only daily brief on the tickers you follow, with charts and news
entries.summary_zh: 只读盯盘日报，附图表和新闻。

entries.name: YC Podcast Notes
entries.summary: Hourly watch on Y Combinator's podcasts with founder-useful notes
entries.summary_zh: 每小时盯 Y Combinator 播客，写出对创始人有用的笔记。

entries.name: YieldSentinel A2H
entries.summary: Checks one DeFi yield position against rules you set before you commit
entries.summary_zh: 你下手前，按你定的规则核一笔 DeFi 收益仓。

entries.name: Yolk
entries.summary: A Tamagotchi egg in your sidebar that wants feeding four times a day
entries.summary_zh: 侧边栏里的电子宠物蛋，一天要喂四次。

entries.name: Youtube分析官
entries.summary: Ranks the best YouTube videos on a topic and writes the brief
entries.summary_zh: 按主题给 YouTube 视频排名，再写成简报。

entries.name: YR Mailchimp
entries.summary: Drafts a Young Republicans club monthly member email and meeting-night reminder in Mailchimp
entries.summary_zh: 在 Mailchimp 起草青年共和党俱乐部月度邮件和会议提醒。

entries.name: Zettelkasten
entries.summary: A slip-box partner for an Obsidian vault that files atomic notes only after you say yes
entries.summary_zh: 给 Obsidian 金库当卡片盒搭档，原子笔记只在你点头后才归档。

entries.name: Zeus
entries.summary: A single HQ chat that picks the next bet, drafts in your voice, and never sends unless you say go
entries.summary_zh: 单一总部对话，挑下一个该押的方向，用你的口吻起草，你不点头就不发。
